clue.text: Fruitful development of clearest system for measuring quakes

indicators.note: a development is a working-out into a new form, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some productive refinement of the clearest method yields a better way of gauging earthquakes.
explanation.definitionFit: The scale devised by Charles Richter rates the magnitude of earthquakes logarithmically from their seismic waves.

clue.text: Express rebuke over identification

parts.note: to rap someone is to criticise them sharply

explanation.surface: A telling-off delivered about someone's ID papers.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: An express train is a fast one, so the adjective express matches quick or speedy.

clue.text: Scheming and playing ironic part also

indicators.note: playing about with something means moving it around freely, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: all fourteen letters are the fodder

explanation.surface: An actor both plots and takes on a sardonic role in the same production.
explanation.definitionFit: Conspirators plot in secret, so a conspiratorial manner is one of plotting and secret intrigue.

clue.text: Chap after endless chat is showing charm

indicators.note: without an end means the final letter of that word is dropped
after says the following word is placed behind what comes before

explanation.surface: A fellow who keeps chatting without stopping is turning on the charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charm' reads as charisma but is the lucky object; chat is TALK, cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: A talisman is an object believed to bring luck or ward off evil, which is a charm in the amulet sense.

clue.text: Party needing some extra vehicles

indicators.note: some of the following words is wanted, so a run of letters is lifted out of them

parts.note: the letters sit across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A big party where more cars are needed to ferry everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A rave is a large all-night dance party, typically with electronic music.

clue.text: Baffled fool set up

parts.note: to con someone is to fool them
to found a company is to set it up

explanation.surface: A dupe left bewildered after being framed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set up' seems to mean framed, but it means established.
explanation.definitionFit: To be confounded is to be perplexed and thrown into confusion, the same as being baffled.

clue.text: Dally with one in group with hesitation

indicators.note: one thing set in another is placed inside it

parts.note: a lot is a group or batch of items

explanation.surface: Someone hanging back with the crowd, unsure what to do.
explanation.definitionFit: To loiter is to linger idly, wasting time, which is just what dallying means.

clue.text: Actor wades in, ideally trained

indicators.note: something trained has been shaped into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: all fourteen letters are the fodder

explanation.surface: A performer who has been properly schooled plunges straight into a role.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface fits his famous commitment to method acting.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel Day-Lewis is the English-born actor who won three Best Actor Oscars, for My Left Foot among others.

clue.text: Song in clip with guys dancing with energy

indicators.note: dancing figures move around, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: a clothes peg clips washing to a line
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A song in a video clip featuring energetic dancing men.
explanation.definitionFit: Peggy Sue is the 1957 rock and roll hit by Buddy Holly, a classic pop record.

clue.text: Bound to turn round new board

indicators.note: turning it round makes the word run the other way
going round something means enclosing it

explanation.surface: Someone obliged to steer a fresh board around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like 'obliged', but it is a jump.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel is a group of people convened to judge or advise, the same as a board.

clue.text: Justify being very mean

parts.note: to mean something is to indicate it

explanation.surface: Defending yourself by claiming to be extremely stingy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like stingy, but it is the verb signify.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate a claim or person is to show they were right, which is to justify them.

clue.text: Overthrow leader in disgrace and rest, right away

indicators.note: right gone away means the letter for right is removed
the leader of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: repose without its R for right

explanation.surface: A disgraced ruler is toppled and sent off to retire at once.
explanation.definitionFit: To depose a ruler is to remove them from power by force, which is to overthrow them.

clue.text: Lion grew terribly menacing

indicators.note: something done terribly is done badly and out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: all eight letters are the fodder

explanation.surface: A big cat became frighteningly threatening.
explanation.walkthrough: Lowering here rhymes with flowering and means frowning darkly, like a lowering sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A lowering look or sky is dark and threatening, so the word means menacing.

clue.text: Shabby field with portion over time engulfed by marsh

indicators.note: something engulfed is swallowed up inside something else

parts.note: a fen is a low marshy area

explanation.surface: A rundown field, part of it swamped by marshland over the years.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' puts the field and portion above the abbreviation for time.
explanation.definitionFit: Flea-bitten literally describes an animal covered in bites, and figuratively anything shabby and worn out.

clue.text: Make more efficient version of metal siren

indicators.note: a version of something is a different form of it, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: all ten letters are the fodder

explanation.surface: Improving the workings of an alarm made of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: To streamline a process is to simplify it and remove waste, so that it runs more efficiently.

clue.text: Work quietly during present strike

indicators.note: happening during something means falling within it

parts.note: to present a play is to stage it
OP is short for opus, a work
P is piano, the musical marking for quiet

explanation.surface: Workers quietly carrying on during a walkout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like now or a gift but is the verb, to put on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoppage is a halt in work by employees as a protest, the same as a strike.

clue.text: Benefit from place with our team

parts.note: PL is the address abbreviation for Place

explanation.surface: A sports fan reflecting on the advantage of a ground shared with the home team.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is an advantage or favourable point, as in 'that is a real plus', the same as a benefit.

clue.text: Invented company with approval excited dupe

indicators.note: something excited is stirred up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A firm gives the go-ahead and an eager victim falls for a fabricated scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A story that is cooked up has been concocted or fabricated, which is to say made up or invented.

clue.text: Curse love at end of speech

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Swearing at the close of an address about love.
explanation.definitionFit: An oath can be a profane exclamation, a swear word, so it serves as another word for a curse.

clue.text: Aspect of expert in person

parts.note: a facet is one aspect of something

explanation.surface: One side of a specialist seen directly.
explanation.definitionFit: Meeting face to face means meeting in each other's actual presence, which is what in person means.

clue.text: Recording absorbing account in principality

indicators.note: absorbing something means taking it inside

parts.note: a mono recording uses a single channel

explanation.surface: A recorded account made in a small royal state.
explanation.definitionFit: Monaco is the tiny sovereign principality on the French Riviera ruled by the Grimaldi princes.

clue.text: Recurring image about revolutionary party with rage

indicators.note: about means placed around, enclosing what follows
a revolution turns things round, so the word it governs runs backwards

explanation.surface: A recurring picture of an angry revolutionary political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary party' suggests a political faction, but party is a celebration and revolutionary turns it and the rage round.
explanation.definitionFit: Something periodic happens at regular intervals, which is to say it keeps recurring.

clue.text: Son takes out gifts

parts.note: to take someone out is to kill them

explanation.surface: A son takes his presents out of their wrapping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Takes out' looks like unpacking or treating, but it is the gangster sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Gifts can mean natural talents or abilities, and skills are exactly such abilities.

clue.text: Odds on bet spread out

parts.note: SP is the starting price, a horse's odds at the off
to lay money is to bet it

explanation.surface: A gambler's wager is laid out across the odds.
explanation.walkthrough: SP, starting price, is the betting odds when a British horse race begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To splay is to spread limbs or parts apart, so splayed things are spread out.

clue.text: Not so much praise without bishop

indicators.note: without means lacking something, so that letter is dropped

parts.note: to bless is to praise, especially God
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: Less acclaim given once the bishop is absent.
explanation.definitionFit: Less is the comparative of little, meaning a smaller amount, exactly as 'not so much' does.

clue.text: Promise to get gold back, surrounded by relative support

indicators.note: something surrounded is enclosed inside another word
going back means the word is read from its end

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
a tee supports a golf ball

explanation.surface: A vow to recover gold, backed up by family members.
explanation.definitionFit: A guarantee is a formal assurance that something will be done, which is a promise.

clue.text: Pin in shadow, elusive

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A pin lost in the shadows proves hard to find.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowel is a headless wooden peg used to fasten pieces of furniture together, a kind of pin.

clue.text: Sentimental stuff I start about bygone pie

indicators.note: about means going around, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: to shy is to start or jump back in alarm

explanation.surface: Nostalgic talk of an old-fashioned pie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start' is the verb to flinch, a sense of shy; a Cornish pasty is a meat and vegetable pastry from Cornwall in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cornish pasty is a folded pastry case filled with beef and vegetables, a kind of savoury pie.
